segments.name: management and franchise
segments.description: Manages and franchises hotels for third-party owners.
segments.evidence: We operate our business through: (i) a management and franchise segment and (ii) an ownership segment, each of which is reported as a segment based on (a) delivering a similar set of products and services and (b) being managed separately given its distinct economic characteristics.

segments.name: ownership
segments.description: Owns and leases hotels and reports their results.
segments.evidence: We operate our business through: (i) a management and franchise segment and (ii) an ownership segment, each of which is reported as a segment based on (a) delivering a similar set of products and services and (b) being managed separately given its distinct economic characteristics.

revenueModel.text: Owners pay management and franchise fees; guests pay room rates at owned hotels.
revenueModel.evidence: The management and franchise segment includes all of the hotels we manage for third-party owners, as well as all properties that license our intellectual property ("IP") and/or use our booking channels and related programs, and where we provide other contracted services, but the day-to-day services of the hotels are operated or managed by someone other than us.
